title: PIXL 8000 Blue Razz Chew Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Chew brings a sweet, nostalgic twist to the PIXL 8000 range with a chewy, confectionery-inspired take on Blue Raspberry. Bright, tangy and smooth, this flavour is ideal for vapers with a sweet tooth. The pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and comes with a 10ml refill reservoir for extended use. Compatible only with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup provides up to 8000 puffs per pod. Mesh coil technology delivers balanced flavour across every draw, while the draw-activated system makes MTL vaping simple and satisfying. Just pop the pod into your PIXL 8000 device and vape. Blue Razz Chew is part of a wide flavour range built for all-day satisfaction.
